## Running Code

Load tidyverse and load the data set, so you can have it in your environment.Load tidyverse and load the data set, so you can have it in your environment.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
fish_data <- read.csv("../Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")
```

Takes a look at the initial values of the data frame, it allows us to look at how is structured.

```{r}
head(fish_data)
```

It creates a new data frame containing the minimun, maximun and the mean of the scale length from our previously loaded data.

```{r}
fish_data2 <- fish_data |> 
  summarise(min_scale_length = min(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            max_scale_length = max(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            mean_scale_length = mean(scalelength, na.rm = T))
fish_data2
```

```{r}
ggplot(fish_data, aes(x = scalelength)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
